newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Antonov to seek Dutch bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: Antonov to seek Dutch bourse listing.

text.p: British gearbox maker Antonov Plc said on Monday it would apply soon for a listing of its shares on the New Market of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange (NMAX).

Antonov has been listed on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) since August 1995. Earlier this month, it expanded its share capital by five percent through placements of new shares with mainly Dutch institutional investors. This has raised about three million pounds, the company said.
On April 11, Antonov posted a 1996 loss before taxes of 1.76 million pounds, slightly down from the 1995 loss of 1.79 million pounds.
